map.物业绩效考核：综合得分 = Σ(六维得分 × 权重) ÷ Σ权重（维度：客户满意: Property performance appraisal: composite = Σ(six dimension scores × weights) ÷ Σ weights (dimensions: customer satisfaction / facility maintenance / response time / fee collection rate / safety compliance / environmental quality). Validation: any non-numeric value reports "Please enter a valid number", and a weight sum of 0 is an error; scores are clamped to [0,100] and negative weights removed. Criteria: >=90 grade A excellent, >=80 grade B good, >=70 grade C acceptable, >=60 grade D needs improvement, <60 grade E non-conforming, with the lowest-scoring dimension identified for priority improvement.
map.六维考核：客户满意度（权重 20，得 90）+ 设施维护（20，85）+ 响应时: Six-dimension assessment: Customer satisfaction (weight 20, score 90) + Facility maintenance (20, 85) + Response time (15, 90) + Payment rate (15, 88) + Safety compliance (15, 92) + Environment quality (15, 85) → Composite = (90×20 + 85×20 + 90×15 + 88×15 + 92×15 + 85×15) ÷ 100 = 88.25.
map.≥90 A级·优秀、80–89 B级·良好、70–79 C级·合格、60–69: ≥90 Grade A Excellent, 80–89 Grade B Good, 70–79 Grade C Pass, 60–69 Grade D Needs improvement, <60 Grade E Fail; 88.25 is Grade B Good. Two consecutive months at Grade D or below triggers training; Grade E triggers interviews and contract review.
